name: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim
source:
Rundown properties in Pinnacove aren’t the only thing in need of fixing… there’s some hearts to mend as well. Luckily, this year's Love Festival seems like a great chance to do just that! Help tragically single residents of Pinnacove with your professional house-flipping skills, and let your heart be filled with the warm satisfaction of a job well done. With a whole slew of inside jokes and meta humor, this love letter to our community gives flipping a whole new meaning!

Everything starts with Tom asking you for just one more favor. Help him decorate the festival venue, and in return, he’ll help you find a date. Apparently, showing up alone just won’t do! Meet some familiar faces and follow different routes, each with minigames, multiple endings, and unique artwork of some of your favourite Pinnacove residents. Will you find love? A great friend? Or end up all alone? The choice belongs to you!

Need a wingman? Bessie’s got your back – failure’s not an option when you’ve got a talking beaver with the ability to bend laws of space and time on your side. Weigh each choice carefully to find your perfect soulmate, but don’t be afraid to mess up! Your guardian cupid assures you’ll always have another chance.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4151070/Heart_Flipper_A_House_Flipper_Dating_Sim/]Steam[/url]]

Spinoff of the [url=https://houseflippergame.com/]House Flipper[/url] simulation game series.
